auth.mfa_code.en: {brand}: your code is {code}. It expires in a few minutes. Do not share it.
auth.mfa_code.es: {brand}: tu codigo es {code}. Vence en pocos minutos. No lo compartas.

signature.invited.en: {brand}: {fullName}, you have a document to sign. Open it here: {link}
signature.invited.es: {brand}: {fullName}, tienes un documento para firmar. Ábrelo aquí: {link}

signature.reminder.en: {brand}: {fullName}, you still have a document to sign. Sign it here: {link}
signature.reminder.es: {brand}: {fullName}, tienes un documento pendiente de firmar. Fírmalo aquí: {link}

signature.certificate_ready.en: {brand}: {fullName}, your signature certificate is ready. Download it: {link}
signature.certificate_ready.es: {brand}: {fullName}, tu certificado de firma está listo. Descárgalo: {link}

signature.certificate_ready.document.en: {brand}: {fullName}, the certificate for {documentTitle} is ready. Download it: {link}
signature.certificate_ready.document.es: {brand}: {fullName}, el certificado de {documentTitle} está listo. Descárgalo: {link}

task.document_rejected.client_message.en: We couldn't process this file. Please upload it again.
task.document_rejected.client_message.es: No pudimos procesar este archivo. Vuelve a subirlo, por favor.

calendar.series_schedule.es: Sigue el horario de la serie

auth.account.client.es: tu cuenta del portal de clientes

auth.security_alert.mfa_disabled.en: Two-step verification was turned off on {account}.
auth.security_alert.mfa_disabled.es: Se desactivó la verificación en dos pasos de {account}.

auth.security_alert.account_locked_out.en: {accountStart} was locked after several failed sign-in attempts.
auth.security_alert.account_locked_out.es: {accountStart} quedó bloqueada tras varios intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión.

auth.security_alert.token_reuse_detected.en: We detected unusual session activity on {account} and signed you out everywhere.
auth.security_alert.token_reuse_detected.es: Detectamos actividad inusual en las sesiones de {account} y cerramos tu sesión en todos los dispositivos.

auth.security_alert.refresh_token_host_m.en: A session of {account} was used from an unexpected address and was closed.
auth.security_alert.refresh_token_host_m.es: Una sesión de {account} se usó desde una dirección inesperada y la cerramos.

auth.security_alert.email_changed.en: The email address of {account} was changed.
auth.security_alert.email_changed.es: Se cambió el correo electrónico de {account}.

auth.security_alert.other.en: We noticed important security activity on {account}.
auth.security_alert.other.es: Detectamos actividad de seguridad importante en {account}.

auth.email_change_requested.client.en: Someone asked to change the email of your client portal account at {office} to {newEmail}.
auth.email_change_requested.client.es: Alguien pidió cambiar el correo de tu cuenta del portal de clientes de {office} a {newEmail}.

auth.email_change_requested.staff.en: Someone asked to change the email of your {office} workspace account to {newEmail}.
auth.email_change_requested.staff.es: Alguien pidió cambiar el correo de tu cuenta de {office} a {newEmail}.

charge_failure.generic.en: The payment could not be completed.
charge_failure.generic.es: No se pudo completar el pago.

charge_failure.no_payment_method.en: There is no payment method on file for automatic payments.
charge_failure.no_payment_method.es: No hay un método de pago guardado para los pagos automáticos.

charge_failure.insufficient_funds.en: The card doesn't have enough available funds.
charge_failure.insufficient_funds.es: La tarjeta no tiene fondos suficientes.

charge_failure.card_expired.en: The card on file has expired.

charge_failure.cvc.en: The card's security code was not accepted.
charge_failure.cvc.es: No se aceptó el código de seguridad de la tarjeta.

charge_failure.card_unusable.en: The card on file can no longer be used.
charge_failure.card_unusable.es: La tarjeta guardada ya no se puede usar.

charge_failure.authentication.en: Your bank asked for an extra confirmation that can't be completed automatically.
charge_failure.authentication.es: Tu banco pidió una confirmación adicional que no se puede completar automáticamente.

charge_failure.processor.en: The payment processor had a temporary problem.
charge_failure.processor.es: El procesador de pagos tuvo un problema temporal.

charge_failure_effect.subscription_suspe.en: your subscription has been suspended and your team can no longer sign in
charge_failure_effect.subscription_suspe.es: tu suscripción se suspendió y tu equipo ya no puede iniciar sesión

charge_failure_effect.seat_suspended.en: the user seat has been suspended and the person assigned to it can no longer sign in
charge_failure_effect.seat_suspended.es: el puesto de usuario se suspendió y la persona asignada ya no puede iniciar sesión

charge_failure_effect.on_hold.en: the service will remain on hold until the payment is completed
charge_failure_effect.on_hold.es: el servicio seguirá en pausa hasta que se complete el pago

wallet.paused.payment_failed.en: We couldn't charge {method} for your {amount} automatic recharge.
wallet.paused.payment_failed.es: No pudimos cobrar a {method} tu recarga automática de {amount}.

wallet.paused.method_unavailable.en: Your saved payment method {method} is no longer available, so we couldn't run your {amount} automatic recharge.
wallet.paused.method_unavailable.es: Tu método de pago guardado {method} ya no está disponible, así que no pudimos hacer tu recarga automática de {amount}.

wallet.paused.other.en: We couldn't run your {amount} automatic recharge with {method}.
wallet.paused.other.es: No pudimos hacer tu recarga automática de {amount} con {method}.
